fieldDescription: Volume of the preview sounds, as a percentage of your [sound effects volume]. [0] mutes them.

The ship your weapons fire at, stripped of weapons and fighters. In [point defense] previews it launches from every missile slot and fighter bay: [Drover] 4 small slots, 2 bays. [Condor] 1 medium slot, 2 bays. [Gemini] 1 medium slot, 1 bay.
How the dummy uses its shield. [Fluctuating] turns it on and off every [6 seconds].
In [point defense] previews, cycles what the dummy launches: missiles, wings, or both.
In [point defense] previews, cycles the dummy's missile: Harpoon, Swarmer, Annihilator, Reaper or Hammer.
In [point defense] previews, cycles the dummy's fighters: Broadsword, Talon or Wasp.
Writes what the previews do to [starsector.log], for troubleshooting. Errors are always logged.
